summary_en: Initial dividend: 18 yen/share in FY12/26 (period-end). Payout ratio target 30% from FY12/27 onwards. Discretionary share buybacks to continue.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Policy Change and Dividend Forecast Revision (Initial Dividend) for FY12/26
translation_en_brief: Medley Inc. announced on 13 August 2026 a change to its dividend policy and revision of its FY12/26 dividend forecast. The company has historically paid no cash dividends since inception, instead reinvesting earnings into growth. However, with FY25 results showing record sales (36.8 billion yen) and EBITDA (4.8 billion yen), and FY26 guidance also indicating continued growth, the board determined it could sustain growth investments while increasing shareholder returns. Medley will pay its first-ever dividend of 18 yen per share as a period-end dividend in FY12/26 (subject to shareholder approval at the March 2027 AGM). From FY12/27 onwards, the company targets a payout ratio of 30% and will continue opportunistic share buybacks to enhance total returns.
